title: State of calamity declared in Northern Samar town over El Niño

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – The municipality of Lope de Vega in Northern Samar was placed under a state of calamity on Wednesday, amid the widespread impact of El Niño now affecting agriculture, livelihoods, and residents’ health. Sangguniang Bayan Resolution No. 15-120 declared the state of calamity, as local officials sought to mobilize resources and provide aid to communities affected by prolonged dry conditions. Municipal records showed that about 917 farmers were affected by El Niño, with agricultural losses estimated at ₱27 million involving 269.65 hectares of farmland.
